Who we are
Built on care, craft & community

Luxury Nail Spa was born from a simple belief — that everyone deserves to feel taken care of. We opened our doors in Fort Myers with a small, passionate team and one goal: to create a space that feels less like a quick appointment and more like a little escape from your day.

Over the years we've become a true neighborhood staple. Whether you're coming in for a classic manicure before a big event, treating yourself to a gel set on a Tuesday just because, or bringing your mom in for a long-overdue pedicure — we're genuinely happy to have you here.

Our technicians are artists at heart. They stay current on the latest trends and techniques so you always leave with nails that feel fresh, personal, and beautifully done. We use professional-grade products, keep our tools sanitized to the highest standard, and take the time to actually listen to what you want — not just what we think looks good.
